title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - Strategic Planning

description.narrative: Develop effective strategies: help organizations formulate clear strategic plans that contribute to achieving their goals effectively.

The General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - Strategic Planning is an initiative aimed at strengthening understanding and practical application of strategic planning in non-profit institutions and communities. The project focuses on training local cadres on how to develop effective strategies that contribute to achieving organizational and community goals.
